messages:
anya: Quick heads up — EU agg window for 2026-03-18 has a late-event spike. We need a short plan to kick off a recompute/backfill. Main asks: routing policy (dedicated vs burst), how many quota slots, and what console visibility we expose (ETA + remaining rows). :eyes:

mike: Can we do a tiny canary first? e.g. recompute a 1h slice to validate counts and perf before blowing up to 5h. 5% of slices -> quick sanity check. :thumbsup:

sophia: agree on canary. Also console needs to show an estimated remaining-rows and expected token cost per slice otherwise oncall will keep DMing. Current console only shows elapsed time. We should add a "remaining_estimate" field in the job API response.

liz: technical note — if we rehydrate KV prefix cache for the 00-02 window we can cut re-tokenization by ~35%. Depends on if prefix hits are stable for that tenant slice. Worth doing in canary.

samir: routing policy suggestion: prefer-dedicated-eu, fallback->shared-burst. Also tag job with operator and tenant id so quota accounting ties back to customer commit.

anya: proposed operator payload for the run (canary):
```
POST /internal/reprocess
{
  "shard": "eu-agg",
  "start": "2026-03-18T01:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-03-18T02:00:00Z",
  "priority": "canary",
  "routing": "prefer-dedicated-eu",
  "tags": ["manual-operator:anya","reason:late-events"],
  "notify": "#eng-platform"
}
```

ops-runner-bot: quota-check: available_slots=12, reserved_slots=3, max_concurrent_recomputes=8.

mike: if available_slots=12 we can schedule canary + 3 concurrent small slices. reserve 2 slots for rollback/urgent.

sophia: UX ask: in the console job list show these fields: status, started_at, progress_pct, remaining_rows_est, estimated_cost_tokens. Also add a simple pause/resume button so oncall can stop a run mid-way if regressions show up.

liz: implementation note — progress_pct should be derived from enumerated shard ranges processed vs total, not from time elapsed. Otherwise it lies if some slices are expensive.

samir: API change: add `remaining_rows_est` to `GET /internal/jobs/:id` and wire to telemetry estimates (sampled count extrapolation). I'll own the API PR if we agree on the field name.

anya: decision check — canary approved. mike to kick off canary. samir will add API field. sophia will update console mock for pause/resume and remaining_est. liz will add KV rehydrate toggle to job config. ops-runner-bot will reserve 2 slots as safety.

mike: I'll run the canary in ~15m. curl snippet for operator run: 
```
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/jobs" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"job_type":"recompute","shard":"eu-agg","start":"2026-03-18T01:00:00Z","end":"2026-03-18T02:00:00Z","priority":"canary"}'
```

deploy-bot: noted: canary job queued on dedicated-eu pool (job_id=job_2026_3978901234_c1).

ops-runner-bot: post-check suggestion: after canary completes, run a lightweight count-diff eval against baseline via `/internal/evals/count_diff?job_id=...` and abort full run on >0.5% mismatch.

sophia: +1 for automated eval gating. add a console pass/fail indicator linked to the eval result so the oncall doesn't need to run scripts.

anya: perfect. Let's reconvene after canary completes. I'll be live on call. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
